S43.01.needs: an image file; a signed-in account
S43.01.note: The "+" menu item "Attach workspace files" and the "/" menu item "Attach file…" both use a text-only picker that rejects images, so only paste and drag work for images.
steps: Run "Code: Open Chat" from the Command Palette (Cmd+Shift+P) to open the chat panel.
Copy a PNG or JPG image, or drag an image file from Finder onto the composer at the bottom.
Look for an attachment chip that shows the file name and a thumbnail.
Type "What is in this image?" in "Describe a task…" and send.
Compare: the reply should describe the image you attached.
S43.01.where: Code: Open Chat > click "Describe a task…" and paste (Cmd+V) an image, or drag an image file onto the composer

S43.02.needs: two or more image files; a signed-in account
S43.02.note: A single drop or paste takes at most 8 files and silently ignores the rest (slice in webviewContent.ts).
steps: Run "Code: Open Chat" from the Command Palette to open the chat panel.
Select 2 or 3 image files in Finder and drag them together onto the composer, or copy several images and press Cmd+V in "Describe a task…".
Check that one chip appears for each image.
Type "Compare these images and list the differences" and send.
Compare: the reply should refer to every attached image, not just one.
S43.02.where: Code: Open Chat > drag several image files onto the composer, or paste several images into "Describe a task…"

S43.03.needs: a screenshot on the clipboard; a signed-in account
S43.03.note: The extension has no capture button of its own; the code comment on the paste handler names grim and the Snipping Tool as sources, and the macOS capture step comes from the OS, not this code.
steps: Run "Code: Open Chat" from the Command Palette to open the chat panel.
Take a screenshot with the macOS screenshot tool so it is copied to the clipboard.
Click in "Describe a task…" and press Cmd+V.
Check that an attachment chip with a thumbnail appears.
Type "Explain what this screenshot shows" and send; compare the reply with what is on the screenshot.
S43.03.where: Code: Open Chat > click "Describe a task…" and paste (Cmd+V) a screenshot

S43.04.needs: a photo or scan saved as JPG or PNG; a signed-in account
S43.04.note: A scanned PDF cannot be attached: non-image binary files are skipped with reason 'unsupported binary attachment' (ChatStateManager.ts), so only image files work; a PDF is not tested here.
steps: Run "Code: Open Chat" from the Command Palette to open the chat panel.
Drag a photo of a printed page (JPG or PNG) onto the composer, or copy it and press Cmd+V in "Describe a task…".
Check that the attachment chip appears.
Type "Read this document and summarize it" and send.
Compare: the reply should read the text on the page and summarize it.
S43.04.where: Code: Open Chat > click "Describe a task…" and paste (Cmd+V) a photo, or drag a photo file onto the composer

S43.05.needs: a chart image file; a signed-in account
steps: Run "Code: Open Chat" from the Command Palette to open the chat panel.
Save a chart as a PNG and drag it onto the composer, or copy it and press Cmd+V in "Describe a task…".
Check that the attachment chip appears.
Type "What trends does this chart show? Give the main values" and send.
Compare: the reply should describe the trend and values shown in the chart.
S43.05.where: Code: Open Chat > drag a chart image onto the composer, or paste it into "Describe a task…"

S43.06.needs: a diagram image file; a signed-in account
steps: Run "Code: Open Chat" from the Command Palette to open the chat panel.
Save a diagram as a PNG and drag it onto the composer, or copy it and press Cmd+V in "Describe a task…".
Check that the attachment chip appears.
Type "Explain the structure of this diagram" and send.
Compare: the reply should name the parts of the diagram and how they connect.
S43.06.where: Code: Open Chat > drag a diagram image onto the composer, or paste it into "Describe a task…"

S43.07.needs: a photo of handwriting saved as JPG or PNG; a signed-in account
S43.07.note: Handwriting is not a separate control; it uses the same image attachment path as the other image items.
steps: Run "Code: Open Chat" from the Command Palette to open the chat panel.
Take a photo of the handwritten notes, save it as JPG or PNG, and drag it onto the composer.
Check that the attachment chip appears.
Type "Transcribe these handwritten notes" and send.
Compare: the reply should give the written text of the notes.
S43.07.where: Code: Open Chat > drag a photo of handwritten notes onto the composer, or paste it into "Describe a task…"

S43.08.needs: an image with readable text; a signed-in account
S43.08.note: No separate OCR control exists in the code; text extraction is a chat request, and the "Copy" button in the code only appears on code blocks, so plain reply text is copied by selection.
steps: Run "Code: Open Chat" from the Command Palette to open the chat panel.
Drag an image containing text onto the composer, or paste it into "Describe a task…".
Type "Transcribe all the text in this image exactly" and send.
When the reply arrives, select the text and press Cmd+C, or use the "Copy" button on a code block in the reply.
Compare: the copied text should match the text in the image and can be pasted elsewhere.
S43.08.where: Code: Open Chat > attach an image, ask for its text, then copy the text from the reply

S43.12.needs: a photo with countable objects; a signed-in account
steps: Run "Code: Open Chat" from the Command Palette to open the chat panel.
Drag a photo with several countable objects onto the composer, or paste it into "Describe a task…".
Type "How many apples are in this image? Count each one" (use your own object) and send.
Compare: the reply should give a count and the count should match the objects you can see.
S43.12.where: Code: Open Chat > attach an image, then ask how many items appear in it

S43.13.needs: two scene photos as image files; a signed-in account
steps: Run "Code: Open Chat" from the Command Palette to open the chat panel.
Select two photos of different scenes in Finder and drag both onto the composer, or copy each and paste into "Describe a task…".
Check that two attachment chips appear.
Type "Describe the differences between these two scenes" and send.
Compare: the reply should describe differences from both photos.
S43.13.where: Code: Open Chat > drag two scene images onto the composer, or paste them into "Describe a task…"

S43.14.needs: a screenshot or photo of a problem as an image file; a signed-in account
steps: Run "Code: Open Chat" from the Command Palette to open the chat panel.
Take a screenshot of the error or a photo of the device, save it as PNG or JPG, and drag it onto the composer.
Check that the attachment chip appears.
Type "What is wrong here and what steps should I try?" and send.
Compare: the reply should name the problem shown and give troubleshooting steps.
S43.14.where: Code: Open Chat > drag a screenshot or photo of the problem onto the composer, or paste it into "Describe a task…"
